60 torsion classes fitted jointly (each class's terms counted in every scanned fragment it sits in, on the scanned bond or another, also where that scan alone would hold it at zero), and the 13 hydrogen-ended classes about the same bonds that the fit held at zero, written as zero so the base library's values do not come back on top of the fit; the census's classes outside OPLS-AA 2024's published table (CAPS's earlier MP2 / machine-learned fits, and classes the table lacks), each scanned on its smallest sound census fragment; every scan's RMS at most 1.0 kcal/mol and every |V| at most 8 kcal/mol

held back, keeping oplsaa2024.json's values (the rest refitted around them): C-CT-CT-NT, CA-CA-CY-O$, OH-CO-CT-OH (V1 of 8.5-10.5 kcal/mol in the first fit); CO-OS-CO-OS, CO-OS-CO-HC, CO-OS-CO-OH (RMS 1.4-1.7 kcal/mol, polyoxymethylene acetal); C-CT-OS-C, OS-C-CT-OS, OH-C-CT-OS, HC-CT-CO-OH (PLA / lactic acid ester and acid: coupled about neighbouring bonds, RMS 1.1-1.4 or |V| 8.9 kcal/mol once refitted together); C-CT-OH-HO, OH-CT-C-OS (the scan broke: a proton moved in most constrained optimisations, lactic acid); CA-NT-CT-CT (RMS 1.06 kcal/mol, a class OPLS-AA 2024 lacks; caps ff complete fills it per structure)
